capabilities: Schedule one-time and recurring reminders with date, time, and recurrence rules
Insert reminders from notes using the :@ trigger and quick actions like today or in one hour
Deliver reminders through Android push, email, Google Calendar, and Telegram channels
Create location-based reminders that fire on arrival via the Notelert Android app
Embed a return link that opens the originating Obsidian note
extras: Reminders require remote backend services (Firebase/Google Cloud) because they must fire while Obsidian is closed; the README details what data is sent, data deletion, and privacy policy. iOS push and location delivery are not available. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule notifications that fire while the app is closed or on other devices.

relations.evidence: Google Calendar: enable its toggle and approve Google OAuth once.
Telegram: enable its toggle, open the Notelert bot, and press Start once.

requires.name: Notelert account via App link token or email verification
Notelert Android app (for push and location reminders)

summary: Reminder plugin that turns selected note lines into scheduled alerts delivered via Android push, email, Google Calendar, Telegram, or location triggers.
